purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.22.0 (adds version 2 of Paper 13, for every k >= 4).
result: 3735 of 3735 modules compiled; 3734 of 3735 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems. Two passes: see runs.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs); OpenAI Codex did not use it during the rebuild (its directories there were last changed on 17 November 2026, 03:20 UTC, according to a directory listing taken after the rebuild)
procedure: New empty output directory; sources copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean and Research/, 3737 files, of which 3735 are Lean modules and 2 are Python scripts of Paper 3). After the build their SHA-256 hashes were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.

Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does. The driver reruns a module automatically (up to five times in each pass) when an attempt ends in a memory or file-read failure rather than a Lean verdict; logs of earlier attempts are kept with the suffix .attemptN. It starts a new Lean process only while enough commit charge (memory reserved by Windows) is free.

In the published logs the local workspace directory is replaced by <workspace> and the directory of the pinned toolchain and packages (ai4math-lean-worker) by <worker>, Windows line endings of status*.json, plan.json, research-olean-constants.txt and run.log are written as Unix line endings, and the byte-order mark at the start of research-olean-constants.txt is removed; nothing else is changed. run.log is empty: the driver writes its progress to status.json.

runs.jobs: up to 16 (free-commit threshold 14 GiB, 5 GiB reserved per start)
runs.note: One start, no restart. Compile phase from 2026-11-17T17:50:52Z to 2026-11-18T01:07:34Z: every module compiled; 5 attempts failed for lack of memory or file access (3 could not read a compiled file, in 2 modules; 2 std::bad_alloc, in 2 modules) and these 4 modules compiled when run again automatically. Leanchecker phase from 01:07:35Z to 07:21:03Z: 626 attempts failed for lack of memory or file access, not because of a proof (624 `leanchecker found a problem ... uncaught exception: failed to read file`, 2 `INTERNAL PANIC: out of memory`), in 237 modules; 198 of them passed when run again automatically, and 39 still could not read a compiled file at their sixth attempt. status-pass1.json is the status at the end of pass 1. No attempt in either pass ended with a Lean error.

Started by a watcher script only after pass 1 had written its end marker (07:21:04Z); the two drivers never ran at the same time. The same driver with --retry-failed and a free-memory threshold of 20 GiB: the 39 modules whose leanchecker run was not recorded as passed in status-pass1.json were replayed again (07:22:59Z to 07:27:03Z), every one at the first attempt of this pass. No module was compiled again: all 3735 compiles had passed in pass 1. Modules that had passed in pass 1 were not rerun.

module_Research.how_counted: readModuleData on Research.olean (research-olean-constants.txt in the log archive)
module_Research.consequence: leanchecker has nothing to replay in this module. It was exempted before the run, as for versions 1.15.0 to 1.21.0.

warnings: 97 lines in 15 older modules, the same lines as for version 1.21.0; none in Paper 13.
axioms: every printed axiom list in the final logs is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The lists printed for TaskH.original_question_two_all_k (by Research.TaskH.OriginalQuestionTwoAssembly), for TaskH.OriginalTests.exact_frozen_question_two (the proof of the frozen statement Question2, by Research.TaskH.OriginalQuestionTwoTests) and for TaskH.case_four, case_five, case_six and case_seven are each exactly these three axioms.
forbidden_tokens: logs/clean-replay-v1.22.0-forbidden-tokens.log: outside comments, only the intentional sorry statements of the comparator challenge files lean/Comparator/ (the same hits as for version 1.21.0).
lean_errors: No attempt ended in a Lean error. Every failed attempt was a memory or file-read failure, and every module passed in the end. (The compile attempts that could not read a file print `error: failed to read file` at the import line, and the leanchecker attempts print `leanchecker found a problem ... uncaught exception: failed to read file`; neither is a verdict on a proof.)
